_comment: Deterministic game fixtures for the seeded local test stack.
The igdb_id values are synthetic and live in a 99xxxx range that IGDB does
not currently allocate, so a seeded instance can never be confused with
cached real IGDB records and a live cache warm will not collide with these.
cover_url is null throughout: GameCard renders its own fallback, and
pointing at remote images would make an offline fixture need the network.
